label: locomotion_kinematics
definition: Measures individual movement such as speed, acceleration, gait, and motion trajectories. Examples: #0, #1, #119.

label: traffic_flow_crowding
definition: Assesses road-user counts, volumes, flow, density, queues, or waiting in pedestrian and micromobility spaces. Examples: #5, #54, #259.

label: crossing_decisions_compliance
definition: Examines crossing choices, intentions, gap acceptance, signal compliance, and other rule-following at crossings. Examples: #29, #39, #107.

label: interactions_conflicts_safety
definition: Assesses encounters among pedestrians, cyclists, scooter users, and vehicles, including yielding, near-conflicts, and collision risk. Examples: #8, #14, #31.

label: spatial_paths_positioning
definition: Examines routes, path shapes, lane or roadway position, and spatial movement choices. Examples: #16, #167, #239.

label: attention_distraction_perception
definition: Assesses gaze, visual attention, distraction, or awareness of surrounding traffic and obstacles. Examples: #17, #66, #333.

label: user_characteristics_modes
definition: Examines road-user demographics, abilities, travel modes, protective equipment, or differences between user groups. Examples: #70, #110, #349.

label: abnormal_behavior_emergency
definition: Assesses atypical movement or behavior, including falls, panic, lingering, and evacuation responses. Examples: #64, #67, #220.

label: infrastructure_environment_conditions
definition: Examines how facilities and ambient conditions—such as lighting, weather, thermal conditions, or surface quality—relate to movement or safety. Examples: #104, #120, #280.

label: hazards_accessibility_cues
definition: Assesses environmental hazards, signs, signals, crossings, or other features relevant to safe and accessible travel. Examples: #81, #139, #225.
